claims.text: Patient reports thinking they are allergic to ibuprofen, which makes them wheezy.

citations.quote: I think I am allergic to ibuprofen, it makes me wheezy.

open_questions: When was the ibuprofen allergy and wheeze first recorded, and how was it documented previously? The record contains only the single patient note and no earlier documentation.
Has the ibuprofen reaction been assessed or confirmed in earlier entries? No assessment or confirmation is recorded.
Are other NSAIDs or alternative analgesics recorded, and were any stopped or switched because of this reaction? No other medications or changes are recorded.
Is there any recorded asthma or prior respiratory reaction to medications? Only the wheeze with ibuprofen is recorded; no asthma history is documented.
Have allergy details been added to the formal allergy list or communicated to other clinicians? The reaction appears only as a patient note.
Which medications were started, stopped, held or changed? No medication changes are recorded.

citation.quote: I think I am allergic to ibuprofen, it makes them wheezy.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Patient-reported ibuprofen reaction with wheeze is only in a free-text patient note and may not be on the structured allergy list.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Clinician to verify the ibuprofen reaction and confirm allergy documentation.
